children: Cencora's revenue rose 5.0% and net income attributable to the company increased from the prior fiscal year, supported by growth in both reportable segments. U.S. Healthcare Solutions growth reflected overall market and unit-volume gains, including higher specialty product sales and an $8.0 billion increase in GLP-1 product sales; International Healthcare Solutions revenue grew 8.3%.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to Cencora, Inc.”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Revenue increased 4.6%, driven primarily by overall market growth and unit-volume gains.
: Sales of products labeled for diabetes and/or weight loss increased $8.0 billion, or 22.2%.
: Revenue rose 8.3%, with increased sales across all businesses in the segment.
: Total segment operating income increased 14.0%; U.S. Healthcare Solutions rose 15.5% and International Healthcare Solutions rose 8.2%.
: Cencora acquired the majority of OneOncology in February 2026 and announced a restructuring of its reporting model effective October 1, 2026.
